native_findings.title: uuid buffer bounds check in Office development tooling
native_findings.affected_surface: development-only TeamsFX and Office add-in tooling
native_findings.repository_disposition: Production npm audit is clean; supported upstream tooling still requires uuid 8.3.2 and a force override is prohibited.
native_findings.native_disposition_comment: Development-only upstream TeamsFX chain; production audit is clean. Evidence: docs/security/dependency-security-maintenance-2026-07-17.md. Reassess on compatible upstream remediation.

risk_acceptance.rationale: Development-only, no production dependency reachability, and the supported upstream graph has no compatible fix.
risk_acceptance.reopen_condition: A compatible TeamsFX graph resolves uuid to 11.1.1 or later, or uuid enters a supported runtime path.

native_findings.title: adm-zip crafted archive memory exhaustion
native_findings.repository_disposition: Supported repository commands do not pass an untrusted ZIP; the affected packages are dev-only.
native_findings.native_disposition_comment: Dev-only archive helpers; supported EMR4 commands do not ingest untrusted ZIPs and production audit is clean. Evidence: docs/security/dependabot-alerts-8-15-triage-2026-08-01.md.

risk_acceptance.rationale: Only trusted local development archive inputs are supported.
risk_acceptance.reopen_condition: An untrusted ZIP ingestion path is added or a compatible Office-toolchain fix becomes available.

native_findings.title: Hono Windows encoded-backslash static-file bypass
native_findings.affected_surface: unused Hono static-file helper in a dev-only MCP dependency
native_findings.repository_disposition: EMR4 does not call the affected serve-static path; its actual dev server is loopback webpack-dev-server.
native_findings.native_disposition_comment: Affected Hono serve-static path is not used; the transitive SDK uses only getRequestListener. EMR4 dev serving is loopback webpack. Evidence: docs/security/dependabot-alerts-8-15-triage-2026-08-01.md.

risk_acceptance.rationale: The advisory sink is absent from supported repository paths.
risk_acceptance.reopen_condition: EMR4 adds Hono static serving or a compatible transitive fix is available.

native_findings.title: fast-xml-parser repeated-DOCTYPE entity-limit reset
native_findings.repository_disposition: No supported repository path parses attacker-controlled XML through the affected Azure helper.
native_findings.native_disposition_comment: Dev-only TeamsFX/Azure parser chain; no supported EMR4 path supplies attacker-controlled XML. Evidence: docs/security/dependabot-alerts-8-15-triage-2026-08-01.md.

risk_acceptance.rationale: Affected parser instance is confined to unused development cloud tooling.
risk_acceptance.reopen_condition: The Azure parser becomes a supported input path or a compatible fix is available.

native_findings.title: fast-uri IDN host-canonicalization confusion
native_findings.affected_surface: Ajv schema-reference parsing in development tools
native_findings.repository_disposition: No host-security decision or network client consumes fast-uri output.
native_findings.native_disposition_comment: Advisory sink is not used: fast-uri is dev-only Ajv normalization, not an EMR4 host policy followed by network access. Evidence: docs/security/dependabot-alerts-8-15-triage-2026-08-01.md.

risk_acceptance.rationale: The host-policy/use precondition does not exist in supported code.
risk_acceptance.reopen_condition: fast-uri output is used for network authorization or a compatible fix is available.

native_findings.title: shell-quote quadratic parse denial of service
native_findings.repository_disposition: shellQuote.parse receives only trusted local editor configuration; request input is not parsed.
native_findings.native_disposition_comment: Dev-only local editor launcher; shellQuote.parse receives trusted editor configuration and dev serving is loopback. Evidence: docs/security/dependabot-alerts-8-15-triage-2026-08-01.md.

risk_acceptance.rationale: Only trusted developer configuration reaches the parser.
risk_acceptance.reopen_condition: Remote/request input reaches shellQuote.parse or a compatible toolchain fix is available.

native_findings.title: js-yaml merge-key quadratic CPU consumption
native_findings.affected_surface: local ESLint and TeamsFX configuration parsing
native_findings.repository_disposition: Only developer-controlled YAML reaches the dev-only parser; no runtime YAML ingestion exists.
native_findings.native_disposition_comment: Dev-only config parser; no EMR4 runtime accepts YAML and the security workflow does not parse untrusted YAML. Evidence: docs/security/dependabot-alerts-8-15-triage-2026-08-01.md.

risk_acceptance.rationale: Only trusted local development configuration reaches the parser.
risk_acceptance.reopen_condition: Untrusted YAML becomes a supported input or a compatible toolchain fix is available.

native_findings.title: brace-expansion exponential-time glob processing
native_findings.repository_disposition: Only trusted source-controlled glob patterns reach the affected dev-only minimatch chain.
native_findings.native_disposition_comment: Dev-only glob expansion receives trusted source-controlled patterns, not request data. Evidence: docs/security/dependabot-alerts-8-15-triage-2026-08-01.md.

risk_acceptance.rationale: No untrusted actor controls a supported glob-pattern input.
risk_acceptance.reopen_condition: Untrusted input becomes a glob pattern or a compatible toolchain fix is available.

native_findings.title: Diary URL flag claimed to bypass confirmation security
native_findings.affected_surface: Diary development/smoke client gating with independent backend authorization
native_findings.repository_disposition: Backend authentication, staff role, evidence, ownership and idempotency controls defeat the claimed authorization impact.
native_findings.native_disposition_comment: Instance-preserving validation found no authorization bypass; backend auth and confirmation authority remain decisive. Evidence: docs/security/codeql-high-validation-2026-07-17.md QH-001.

risk_acceptance.rationale: The query's claimed security consequence is defeated by the backend boundary.
risk_acceptance.reopen_condition: Backend authorization or smoke-mode data boundaries materially change.

native_findings.title: D5 aggregate reporter claimed to log sensitive data
native_findings.repository_disposition: Safety assertions restrict output to aggregate metadata and exclude protected fields.
native_findings.native_disposition_comment: Reporter emits aggregate metadata only and rejects protected fields. Evidence: docs/security/codeql-high-validation-2026-07-17.md QH-009.

risk_acceptance.rationale: The reported value is non-sensitive aggregate metadata.
risk_acceptance.reopen_condition: Reporter output fields or source evidence change.

native_findings.title: route inventory reporter claimed to log sensitive data

risk_acceptance.rationale: The reported value is non-sensitive aggregate route metadata.
risk_acceptance.reopen_condition: Reporter output fields or execution behavior change.
